caption: The drawing depicts a large, rounded earthenware pot with two looped handles on either side near the rim. The pot is primarily a light brown color with shading to suggest its three-dimensional form. On the front of the pot, there is a painted blue image of a bird with outstretched wings and a shield-like pattern on its body; the bird is holding a branch in each claw, one on the left and one on the right, both rendered in blue. Above the pot, in the upper left corner of the image, there is a small rectangle containing another blue design, which appears to be a stylized floral or leaf motif with five rounded, petal-like shapes and a small circular shape at the end. The pot and the inset rectangle are outlined with fine lines, and the artist’s signature “Yolande DeLasser” is written in the lower right corner of the page. The background is a plain, beige or cream color.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
